title.en: The Decision of the Panchayat: the story in brief

text.en: A farmer buys a well, but his neighbour says the water was not sold.

Once there lived a farmer in a small village who worked very hard. When he prospered he bought another field with a well next to it, buying the well from his neighbour because he needed water for his fields.
The neighbour was cunning and planned to cheat him. The next day he stopped the farmer at the well and said he had sold only the well, not the water.
The worried farmer went to the village chief, who fixed a day for a meeting of the Panchayat under the banyan tree in the centre of the village.
At the meeting both men were summoned. The farmer explained. The cunning man repeated his claim, and the members and villagers tried to reason with him but he was adamant.
The chief said that it was right that only the well was sold. But if the water was still his, he had no business keeping his water in the farmer's well. He must remove it or use it up immediately, otherwise it would belong to the owner of the well.
The farmer was relieved and shouted with joy. The neighbour realised that cheating does not pay, paid a fine and apologised, and the villagers praised the wisdom of the Panchayat.
